$comment: The three services the business offers. This is the single source of truth for both the website copy and what the AI agent may say a service includes. Adding a service here makes the agent offer it - do not add one the business does not actually provide.

services.name: Office & Commercial Cleaning
services.audience: For offices, studios, retail units and managed workspaces
services.summary: A scheduled, contract-quality clean that keeps your workplace presentable for staff, clients and building management. Daily, several times a week, or weekly - always by the same vetted team wherever possible.
includes: Desks, workstations, meeting rooms and communal surfaces sanitised
Floors vacuumed and hard floors mopped throughout
Kitchens and breakout areas cleaned, with appliances wiped down
Washrooms cleaned, sanitised and restocked with your consumables
Waste and recycling collected and taken to your designated point
Touch points - handles, switches, lift buttons - disinfected
Reception and client-facing areas presented to a front-of-house standard
excludes: External window cleaning above ground floor
proofPoints: Out-of-hours and weekend slots so your working day is never disrupted
A named account contact and a documented cleaning specification
Key-holding and alarm procedures agreed in writing before we start
services.priceHint: Priced on floor area, frequency and scope. Ask for an estimate in the chat, or request a site visit.

services.name: End of Tenancy Cleaning
services.audience: For estate agents, letting agents, landlords and Airbnb hosts
services.summary: A full property clean prepared to inventory-checkout standard, with before and after photographs supplied as evidence. Built for agents and landlords who need a property turned around quickly and let again without dispute.
includes: Kitchen deep cleaned, including cupboards inside and out
Appliances cleaned inside, including oven, hob and extractor
Bathrooms descaled, sanitised and polished throughout
Limescale removed from taps, screens, tiles and sanitaryware
All floors vacuumed, mopped and edges detailed
Skirting boards, doors, frames, switches and sockets wiped
Interior windows, sills and frames cleaned
Cobwebs removed and light fittings dusted
excludes: Removal of tenants' belongings or bulky waste
proofPoints: Photographic before and after record supplied with every job
Our re-clean guarantee covers you if the inventory clerk raises a point
Rapid turnarounds for agents working to a check-in date
services.priceHint: Priced on the number of bedrooms, the condition of the property and any extras such as carpets or ovens.

services.name: Domestic Cleaning
services.audience: For homeowners, tenants and busy households across London
services.summary: Regular or one-off cleaning of your home by the same trusted, DBS-checked cleaner wherever possible, worked to a checklist you agree with us in advance.
includes: Kitchen surfaces, sink and appliance exteriors cleaned
Bathrooms cleaned, sanitised and polished
Dusting and wiping of all reachable surfaces
Floors vacuumed and mopped throughout
Beds made and general tidying to your instructions
Bins emptied and liners replaced
excludes: Clearance of hoarded or heavily soiled properties
Cleaning requiring ladders above two metres
Care or childcare duties of any kind
proofPoints: Weekly, fortnightly or one-off visits to suit your household
The same cleaner each visit wherever scheduling allows
All products and equipment supplied unless you prefer your own
services.priceHint: Priced on the number of bedrooms, how often you would like us, and any extras.

not_offered.$comment: Requests matching these are declined politely and escalated. The live merrycleaners.co.uk site lists some of these; they are excluded here because the owner's brief named three services only. Add a service above if the business decides to offer it through this system.
not_offered.response: We specialise in office cleaning, end of tenancy cleaning and domestic cleaning, so that particular service sits outside what we provide. A member of our team is happy to point you in the right direction if that would be useful.
